name: Segment Anything
description: Segment Anything is a large-scale image segmentation dataset and task designed to enable zero-shot transfer to new image distributions and tasks. It includes over 1 billion masks on 11 million images and is accompanied by a promptable segmentation model.
reputation: A highly influential and widely adopted vision benchmark that helped popularize promptable zero-shot segmentation and became a standard reference in segmentation research.
notes: Largest segmentation dataset to date with over 1 billion masks; designed for zero-shot transfer.
